description: Source code defining the OutgoingOAuthConnection model, related types, validation, and filtering for OAuth connections in Mattermost.

classes.name: OutgoingOAuthConnection
classes.description: Represents an OAuth connection with methods for validation, sanitization, patching, and cache ETag generation.

classes.name: OutgoingOAuthConnectionGetConnectionsFilter
classes.description: Filter parameters for retrieving OAuth connections with default setting and URL conversion.

classes.name: OutgoingOAuthConnectionToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth token with method to format as authorization header.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the OutgoingOAuthConnection object for required fields and correctness.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Removes sensitive information from the connection object.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Updates the connection object with non-empty fields from another connection.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of audit-relevant fields.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Sets ID and timestamps before saving.

methods.name: SetDefaults
methods.description: Sets default limit for connection filtering.

methods.name: ToURLValues
methods.description: Converts filter parameters to URL query values.

methods.name: AsHeaderValue

methods.name: HasValidGrantType
methods.description: Validates the grant type and associated credentials.
